Star of Mysore.title: Dasara elephants arrive at Mysore Palace for Jamboo Savari rehearsals
Star of Mysore.contentSnippet: The first batch of nine elephants led by Abhimanyu were welcomed at the Jayamarthanda Gate with traditional puja before beginning their weight-bearing drills for the Jamboo Savari procession.

Star of Mysore.title: Palace illumination timings extended for Dasara fortnight
Star of Mysore.contentSnippet: The Mysore Palace Board has announced that the palace will be illuminated from 7 pm to 10 pm every day during Dasara, an hour longer than usual.

Star of Mysore.title: Two held for chain snatching in Vijayanagar
Star of Mysore.contentSnippet: Police arrested two youths for allegedly snatching gold chains from women in Vijayanagar.

The Hindu — Karnataka.title: Dasara elephants reach Mysuru Palace, rehearsals for Jamboo Savari to begin
The Hindu — Karnataka.contentSnippet: Nine elephants, including Abhimanyu, were accorded a traditional welcome at the palace on Saturday. Forest officials said rehearsals would begin next week.

The Hindu — Karnataka.title: Yaduveer Wadiyar to hold private durbar at palace during Navaratri
The Hindu — Karnataka.contentSnippet: The golden throne will be assembled in the Durbar Hall ahead of the traditional private durbar held by the scion of the erstwhile royal family during Navaratri.
